2609.35412.title: Self-Adapting Group of Experts for Multi-Agent Reasoning
2609.35412.paper_summary: Multi-agent systems bring together language model agents with different roles to propose, review, and refine solutions. Each agent's response depends on its model's capabilities, the reasoning strategy defined by its system prompt, and the information in its input context. Existing frameworks often adapt communication by changing this context while leaving individual prompts fixed, even when a problem calls for different skills. We study whether agents' initial responses can identify a strategy better suited to the current problem and guide its transfer to other agents. To address this, we introduce SAGE (Self-Adapting Group of Experts), a training-free framework that uses answer agreement, prefix consistency, and reciprocal peer review to select a strategy donor. SAGE transfers the selected donor's reasoning strategy to the other agents while preserving their original roles. This transfer uses only the agents' original system prompts, without access to the problem or generated solutions. After strategy adaptation, agents exchange responses through a dynamic, sparse directed acyclic graph that routes information from higher-scoring agents to lower-scoring agents. Experiments across multiple agent backbones and reasoning benchmarks show that SAGE achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/atifquamar07/sage.
2609.35412.paper_summary_zh: 多智能體系統將具有不同角色的語言模型代理結合在一起，以提出、審查和完善解決方案。每個代理的回應取決於其模型的能力、由其系統提示定義的推理策略以及其輸入上下文中的信息。現有框架通常通過改變這個上下文來調整通信，同時保持個別提示不變，即使問題需要不同的技能。我們研究代理的初始回應是否能識別出更適合當前問題的策略，並指導其轉移到其他代理。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了 SAGE（自適應專家組），這是一個無需訓練的框架，利用答案一致性、前綴一致性和相互同行評審來選擇策略捐贈者。SAGE 將所選捐贈者的推理策略轉移到其他代理，同時保留它們的原始角色。這種轉移僅使用代理的原始系統提示，而不訪問問題或生成的解決方案。在策略適應後，代理通過一個動態、稀疏的有向無循環圖交換回應，該圖將信息從高分代理路由到低分代理。跨多個代理骨幹和推理基準的實驗顯示，SAGE 的平均準確率高於評估的基準。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/atifquamar07/sage 獲得。
